name: Heartnet
summary: A beating heart of 320 glowing dots joined by threads of light, with your message inside
about: Hundreds of dots fly in and settle into a heart, joined to their neighbours by fine lines that brighten with every beat, while each beat sends a heart-shaped shockwave out and small hearts drift up far behind. Your cursor pushes the dots aside and leaves a glitter trail, and a click scatters them in a burst of sparks before they pull back together. Good for a love note, a charity or health page, or a striking hero background.
how: The dots fly in from all over the screen and form the heart.
The heart beats with a lub-dub rhythm and a shockwave on every beat; set the speed with the Beat slider.
Move your mouse or finger over it to push the dots away; click anywhere to scatter them in a burst of sparks.
Type a message to show in the middle and choose a rose, violet or gold colour.
With reduced motion the heart stays still and a pulse only brightens it.
